Body Type Calculator

Classify a clothing-fit silhouette from bust, waist, and hip measurements using transparent ratio rules. The output is a descriptive shape label for garment-fit exploration, not a health or personality category. The comparison uses bust-to-hip and waist-to-bust/hip proportions with a small tolerance band to identify balanced, pear, inverted-triangle, or straighter silhouettes.

How to use this calculator

  1. Enter bust circumference, waist circumference, hip circumference.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How body type is calculated

The comparison uses bust-to-hip and waist-to-bust/hip proportions with a small tolerance band to identify balanced, pear, inverted-triangle, or straighter silhouettes. A larger hip measure than bust tends toward the pear-shaped fit category in this simple rule set.

Descriptive silhouette from bust, waist, and hip circumference comparisons.

Assumptions & useful context

Informal clothing-fit description only; thresholds are simple heuristics and do not describe health.

Health calculations are estimates for education. They cannot diagnose a condition or replace a clinician’s assessment. Individual needs vary, especially during pregnancy, illness and growth.

Frequently asked questions

Does body type say anything about health?

No. These labels only compare external measurements.

Will this guarantee clothing fit?

No. Brands and garment cuts use different sizing systems.
